TEXT: [FI] I arrived at the Game Center in front of the station.
[FI] The place is as noisy as ever.

[FI] For starters, I'll check the fighting game corner 
where she's likely to be.

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_1
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=28]Whoaa! Finally, a 100-win streak![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_2
TEXT: [FI] She's ridiculously strong! And a beauty too...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh...
[FI] Could that be Kuroneko?

[FI] I made my way through the crowd, trying to catch 
a glimpse of this female gamer who achieved a 
100-win streak.
[FI] However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Not her.

[FI] There seems to be female gamers who are as 
skilled as Kuroneko.
[FI] Maybe she's the one Sena was talking about.
[FI] Well, that's the least of my worries right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Can't find her.
[FI] Is she even in here?

[FI] In the midst of giving up and having no luck, I 
headed to the remaining medal game corner.
[FI] When I arrived...

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_4
TEXT: [FI] You're doing it!

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_4
TEXT:
[FI] Kuroneko-san! You are a genius! Indeed, the cat 
that descended to darkness...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Whoa now... That voice sounds so familiar.
[FI] I approached the voice in a hurry and-
[FI] ...it was this very scene you see here.
[FI] Hey... What does one make of this?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...Hmph... You shouldn't be surprised over something 
as trivial as this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Look, here it comes again.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=44]Kyaaa!①[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] Beautiful! How did you do that?! It's not just 
targeting a winning sequence, right?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...Fufu... It's intuition. I am sensing the waves of 
darkness.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] I don't really understand but that doesn't matter! 
As expected of Kuroneko-san!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] My current form is not known as Kuroneko, but 
Yamineko. Please don't be mistaken.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: [FI] Yes, Yamineko-san, right? Okay, okay!

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, so, can you do the same with the other 
machines too?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] A simple task.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=33]Impressive! I love you, 
Kuroneko-san![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Please stop saying such disgusting things.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] Kufufufu... *slurp*! If I can use this girl's skills, I'll 
definitely be riding the gravy train! Victory! The 
ending of Oreimo!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What are you doing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=44]!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] O-Oh, I thought it was some random person but it's 
just Kyousuke-kun. What's up?

[FI] ...Uh, there may be people who might not recognize 
her, so I'll explain.

[FI] This money-monger of a woman is Iori Fate 
Setsuna.

[FI] Many things happened and she became 
unemployed, a Legendary Freeter, one who 
survives through part-time jobs.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] What do you mean "what's up?" What are you 
doing in a place like this?

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: [FI] Can't you tell by looking? I'm hitting the slots!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I can tell! I don't mean that, but about what you're 
scheming while embracing Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] You've seen it too, haven't you? That impossible 
Super Winning Sequence Technique!

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] If it's her, she can easily conquer it! That thing 
which ruined so many gamblers, that-

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Okay stop right there.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] Aw, what's with you? I was getting to the good 
part.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I get the gist of it, even if you don't say it.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: [FI] Well! In that case, this discussion is simple!

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: [FI] That's how it is, so please pray for our success.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Like hell I will![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Please don't involve Kuroneko in your shady 
scheme.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: [FI] But it's not a shady scheme~

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: [FI] It's gambling your life away for the final victory~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's even worse!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] *sigh*... Come on, let's go, Kuroneko. You shouldn't 
associate yourself with such people.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Kuroneko? Who might that be?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] I am the angel of vengeance "Yamineko"... An 
abominable being whose heart was ruined by the 
darkness.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Leave, human. I shall continue down this path of 
destruction.
[FI] Not good.
[FI] Kuroneko is straying from the right path.

[FI] I had my suspicions that she's slightly off from 
usual, going by what Hinata-chan said, but-

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hmph. I've told you already.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Right now... I'm the angel of vengeance, Yamineko.
[FI] Ah, so she hasn't recovered from that yet.
[FI] In fact, it looks like things might be getting worse.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: [FI] See? You heard her, didn't you?
[FI] Fate-san pointed sternly at my face.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: [FI] Humans like you should just go back home!

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] Yes, we are fallen angels, staking our lives in this 
game of darkness...

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: [FI] This is no place for the likes of you.
[FI] She has regressed, she has regressed!
[FI] Even this one has regressed into a middle schooler!
[FI] This aura of "Yamineko" is terrifying.
[FI] The "sickness" known as Chuunibyou...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...This isn't contagious, right?
